SECOND: the palette-table argument expression address((ByteBuffer) packedPal.rewind()) threw ClassCastException, aborting fullSync per chunk (dv3: FULL_SYNCS=0, registerChunk swallowed it into lastError). Precise mechanism (git-recovered 4c2dec3:1006-1009): packedPal was created by ByteBuffer.asIntBuffer(), so the OBJECT is an IntBuffer VIEW (runtime type: the package-private ByteBufferAsIntBuffer class); rewind() returns that same view object, and an IntBuffer view is a SIBLING of ByteBuffer under Buffer — never an instance of it, so the cast must fail at runtime. The erased Buffer return type of rewind() only explains why the compiler ACCEPTED the cast, not why it ran hot; the fix addresses the BACKING ByteBuffer (the view exposes no ByteBuffer facade over the same memory). dv3 logs hold only the truncated lastError string (no runtime-type text): construction site recovered from git, not from a saved stack.
